paragraphs: Today is a big day at school. Lily's grandma and grandfather come to the lesson. The class stands in a line. Teacher Kim stands at the door. "Good morning, Grandma!" says Teacher Kim. "Good morning, Grandfather!" "Hello, Teacher Kim," says Grandma. Grandfather has a gray hat. Lily is very happy.

Mia is a girl in the class. She does a wai. "Hello, Grandma!" says Mia. Ben does a wai too. "Hi, Grandfather!" says Ben. Leo is at the end of the line. He waves his hands. "Hello, hello, hello!" says Leo. Grandma smiles and says, "Hello, Mia!" "Hello, children!" says Grandfather.

Then the lesson starts. Grandfather has a book. "Today I tell a story," says Grandfather. The children sit and listen. At the end, Grandma says, "Goodbye, children!" "Goodbye, Grandma!" say the children. "Bye, Grandfather!" says Lily. "See you!" says Grandfather. Grandma has a small bag of candy. Lily holds Grandma's hand. Do you say hello to your grandma?
text.summary: Lily's grandma and grandfather come to her class. The children stand in a line and say hello in different ways, and at the end they say goodbye.
